# Data Model: session-orchestration
<!-- Generated by /hef.plan -->
<!-- Date: 2026-09-27 -->

## Ledger entry — `<git-common-dir>/hefesto/ledger/<id>.json`

One file per board item. Written only by `hooks/ledger.sh` (atomic: temp file in the same dir + `mv`).
Never committed; shared by every worktree of the repository through the common git dir.

```json
{
  "id": "HEF-1",
  "source": { "kind": "tasks-repo", "ref": "tasks/TODO.md#HEF-1", "url": null, "body_sha256": "…" },
  "route": null,
  "phase": "queued",
  "owner": null,
  "worktree": null,
  "branch": null,
  "spec_dir": null,
  "pr": null,
  "verdicts": [],
  "blocked_on": null,
  "budget": { "usd_cap": 5, "usd_spent": 0 },
  "runs": [],
  "attempts": 0,
  "created": "2026-09-27T21:00:00Z",
  "updated": "2026-09-27T21:00:00Z"
}
```

| Field | Type | Written by | Rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phase` | enum | `advance` | `queued → intake → spec → plan → plan-review → tasks → implement → verify → quality → security → pr → merged → released`; forward only (skips allowed) |
| `route` | `fix\|light\|full\|null` | launcher from worker output | — |
| `owner` | `{session_name, role, pid, started}` | `claim` | exactly one; second claim → non-zero, no write |
| `worktree`, `branch` | string | launcher after the implement run | `git -C <worktree> branch --show-current` |
| `pr` | `{url, number}` | launcher from worker output | — |
| `verdicts[]` | `{gate, verdict, by, at, evidence}` | `verdict` | `gate ∈ verify\|review\|quality\|scan\|mutate`; `gate=review` requires `by ≠ owner.session_name` |
| `blocked_on` | `{kind, since, question_path}\|null` | `block`/`unblock`; launcher from worker output | kinds `human:clarify\|human:plan-review\|human:merge\|human:intake\|ci\|conflict\|budget\|stall` |
| `budget.usd_spent` | number | launcher (`+= total_cost_usd`) | daily total = sum over entries with `updated` today |
| `runs[]` | `{role, session_id, exit, usd, at}` | launcher | audit trail |
| `attempts` | int | `claim` | `> 2` → `blocked_on: stall`, claim exits non-zero |

### State machine (who moves what)

| Event | Written by | Transition |
|---|---|---|
| `init` | orchestrate | `phase: queued` |
| `next` | orchestrate | selects `owner:null ∧ blocked_on:null ∧ phase ∈ {queued, implement}` |
| `claim` + `advance implement` | launcher (implement) | `owner` set, `attempts += 1` |
| `run` | launcher, after the process exits | `runs[] += …`, `usd_spent += …`, **`owner: null`** |
| outcome `pr` | launcher | `record --pr --branch --worktree --route`, `advance verify` |
| outcome `blocked` | launcher | `block <kind>` (phase stays) |
| outcome `failed` / non-zero exit | launcher | phase stays `implement`; re-dispatchable until `stall` |
| verify run, all verdicts PASS | launcher (verify) | `verdict` ×n, `advance pr`, `block human:merge` |
| verify run, any FAIL | launcher (verify) | `verdict` ×n, `block verdict` (phase `verify`; a human decides in Phase 1) |
| human merges | orchestrate or human | `unblock` (evidence: ancestor of `main`) → `advance merged` |
| `human:*` block | only a human command produces the evidence | orchestrate never calls `unblock` on these |

### Unblock evidence per `human:*` kind

| Kind | Evidence checked by `ledger unblock` |
|---|---|
| `human:plan-review` | `grep -q '^## Reviewed' <spec_dir>/plan.md` (same test as `speckit-helper.sh check-plan-review`) |
| `human:clarify` | `! grep -q 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' <spec_dir>/spec.md` |
| `human:merge` | `git merge-base --is-ancestor <branch> main` |
| `human:intake` | `--reviewed-by-human` **and** `[ -t 0 ]` |
| `ci`, `conflict`, `budget`, `stall`, `verdict` | no evidence required (the orchestrator may clear them after a human command) |

## Structured output contracts (`--json-schema`)

Embedded as heredocs in `session-launch.sh`; the worker and verifier fill them, the launcher reads
`.structured_output` from the `--output-format json` result.

`contracts/implement-result.json`:
```json
{ "type": "object", "required": ["summary", "route", "outcome"],
  "properties": {
    "summary":   { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "route":     { "enum": ["fix", "light", "full"] },
    "outcome":   { "enum": ["pr", "blocked", "failed"] },
    "pr_url":    { "type": ["string", "null"] },
    "blocked_on":{ "type": ["string", "null"],
                   "enum": ["human:clarify", "human:plan-review", "human:merge", "ci", "conflict", null] },
    "spec_dir":  { "type": ["string", "null"] } } }
```

`contracts/verify-result.json`:
```json
{ "type": "object", "required": ["summary", "verdicts"],
  "properties": {
    "summary":  { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "verdicts": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object",
      "required": ["gate", "verdict"],
      "properties": { "gate": { "enum": ["verify", "review", "quality", "scan", "mutate"] },
                      "verdict": { "enum": ["PASS", "FAIL", "SKIPPED"] },
                      "evidence": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 } } } } } }
```

## `orchestrate` block in `.claude/project-status.json`

```json
"orchestrate": {
  "usd_cap": 5, "daily_usd_cap": 25,
  "tiers": { "implement": "opus", "verify": "fable" },
  "allowed_tools": {
    "implement": ["Read", "Edit", "Write", "Glob", "Grep", "Skill", "Agent",
                  "Bash(git *)", "Bash(gh pr create *)", "Bash(gh pr view *)", "Bash(bash tests/smoke.sh*)"],
    "verify":    ["Read", "Glob", "Grep", "Skill", "Agent", "Bash(git diff*)", "Bash(git log*)",
                  "Bash(bash tests/smoke.sh*)", "Bash(gitleaks *)"] } }
```
Defaults apply when the block or a key is absent. Any value matching `claude-[a-z]+-[0-9]` is refused.
